required_fixes.description: False provenance attribution: the repaired F-1 text states the accepted gate records a 'dense 174k AUC = 0.482 FAIL' (report L30, L75, L88, L159; and three places in factory_direction.json). Accepted evidence attributes 0.482 to a SPARSE representation, not dense. Source artifact core/evaluation/results/evaluation/citation_heritage_174k.json (run citation_heritage_174k_1790199246) has embedding='cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5_174k', auc_roc=0.481957, n_pos=804, status=FAIL. The accepted evaluation audit CYCLE_38037204821.md L108 labels the row 'Citation Heritage AUC (cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5_174k) | 0.482 | FAIL'; its dense row is separately 'center_projected_64dim | 0.7922 | PASS (partial)'. Accepted gate CYCLE_35949306163_GATE.json: 'Citation heritage FAIL on TF-IDF (AUC=0.482) ... dense embeddings required'; CYCLE_38008331991_GATE.json lists 'full 174k dense BLOCKED'. The accepted evaluation state (evaluation.json dense_embedding_complementary_acceptance_criteria.citation_heritage_view) records dense citation-heritage as DENSE_NOT_EMPIRICALLY_VALIDATED_BLOCKED_ON_CITATION_GRAPH_COVERAGE with note 'All dense citation heritage runs at 174k scale FAILED with Insufficient valid pairs'. Therefore no dense 174k AUC exists, and the sentence is internally self-contradictory (it says dense runs failed for insufficient pairs and then cites a dense AUC). This misstates accepted evidence, violates the Master Prompt non-negotiable 'Preserve provenance', and propagates into resumable lane question text. Root cause: the prior audit's own F-1 repair_action used the imprecise phrase 'dense 174k AUC=0.482 FAIL', implying a validated dense result that never existed; this repair carried that imprecision forward.
required_fixes.repair_action: Replace every 'dense 174k AUC = 0.482 FAIL' with an accurate statement: the 174k citation-heritage run for the sparse 'cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5' representation scored AUC 0.482 (FAIL; citation_heritage_174k.json, n_pos=804), while DENSE citation-heritage at 174k was not measured (all dense runs FAILED with 'insufficient valid pairs'; status DENSE_NOT_EMPIRICALLY_VALIDATED_BLOCKED_ON_CITATION_GRAPH_COVERAGE). Remove the self-contradiction. Apply to report L30/75/88/159 and to state/factory_direction.json lanes.legal-distance.question, lanes.evaluation.question, and director_note. No routing change is implied.

required_fixes.description: Weak acceptance test: product resumption item (c) ('surface the documented cross-language limitation honestly in the API/UI instead of implying cross-lingual neighbours') has no measurable success rule, unlike items (a), (b) and (d) which each carry a concrete, falsifiable acceptance test. Under the Master Prompt evaluation doctrine a success rule is required before claim-bearing work; item (c) therefore cannot be adjudicated on completion.
required_fixes.repair_action: Add a falsifiable acceptance test for item (c), e.g. 'for a defined sample of cross-language neighbour results, the API/UI surfaces the language-dominance qualifier and never presents a cross-language neighbour as language-consistent; qualifier present for 100% of sampled cross-language pairs.' Textual only.
